purpose: Lift-shaped multi-session personas for temporal resolution: a later statement resolves or changes an earlier one in DIFFERENT words. Covers resolved blockers, deadlines, prices, project status, reversed decisions, negation, corrections, several changes in one message, conflicting evidence, completed commitments, historical vs current questions, and an UNRESOLVED blocker as a control.
